[**Good for the price - but be aware of drawbacks**](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6ab2307c3eacdb83d5be9dad)

Honest review. Have had a Peloton bike since 2019, increasingly cross at the price they charge bike owners for their app I was semi-relived when the screen started misbehaving. I had the choice of buying a new screen (£500), new bike (£2000) or switching and reducing app level to something more reasonable. Thought long and hard about a Yesoul bike (ultimately bought the G1M Plus). Arrived promptly, simple to put together and after adjusting the crank slightly (arrived loose) I was away.

Good things

\- Price (£500 is a lot of money but it's a lot less than a Peloton)

\- Build quality (am 3 rides in, seems ok)

\- Much cheaper classes (the streaming method is great)

\- soundbar very good, screen quality also ok.

\- flywheel is so quiet, much quieter than Peloton

Annoying things

\- do check that your phone is valid for screen sharing before buying - many aren't, have had to source a reconditioned samsung specifically for the bike after arrival, Google pixel and iphone didn't work.

\- handlebars - are low (I'm 6'3") and uncomfortable (very little padding)

\- bottle holders are in a daft place

\- resistance is weak. I reckon what would have been a "50" on the Peloton is more than a "90" on the Yesoul so a really strenuous climb is all but impossible and the "knob" seems a bit disconnected from the resistance. It's also quite light so when you put the power down it will jump and move.

\- Native software is basic

\- you'll want to change the saddle

Don't regret the purchase (yet) will see how it goes over time.
